text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash. Splash.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(A beach with a southern view of the
ocean...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah. This is the perfect place to
refresh my qi. I
can start over from
square one.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna put more focus on running this
fall. And
rather than trying to win
people over with words...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to prove the power of feng
shui with my
running! I'll make everyone
truly believe in it, and
show them the
way to happiness!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Rickey?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah, I think I'm gonna take a step
back
from media appearances and start
focusing more
on running. Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? That you should try
to avoid
those detours.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Though, I guess it goes to show how versatile you are. I know I couldn't handle so many different things at once.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I can only focus on one thing at a time. I
just want
everyone to learn more about
Tomakomai—the
hometown I love so
much.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how hard I tried as a local
idol... I
just couldn't bring people in.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No one paid any attention to me. Some
even
suggested I should just be a regular
idol and stop
making it about my
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There were times where I thought things
would
stay tough no matter what I did...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But the Twinkle Series is different. If I
win,
everyone takes notice of me, and I
get the chance
to draw attention to my
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's why I run. Because if I don't get
any results
from my running, I won't get
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm so close to being a top-class dirt
runner. And
every single victory helps
out Tomakomai that
much more.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So I've made up my mind. This fall and
winter, I'm
going to run every chance I
get!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The JBC Classic, the Champions
Cup—every big
race that comes my way!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know you're out to catch up to me,
Rickey, but
I've got Acute to catch up to
myself. ...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. I was just talking to
Tarumae, and...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think catching up to her might be
tricky.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
About her passion for racing. Tarumae's
come this
far without ever hesitating.
She's stayed right on
the path she set
her mind on.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, in hindsight, maybe doing all
those TV
appearances hurt my chances,
in the long run.
But...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No way! We'll get back into the groove
together!
And then...
choice_data_list_en: You're not giving up, are you?
You wouldn't give up, would you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When the Champions Cup rolls around,
I'm gonna
take on Tarumae with all I've
got! I'll show her
what feng shui can do
for my running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey is in her classic year,
while Hokko
Tarumae is in her senior
year. Anyone could see
the difference in
their ability. Still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's going to change unless she
challenges
herself. Which means I'll have
to train her so she's
ready to take on
anything that comes her way.
